title: Claims Handler - Defendant Personal Injury (EL/PL)
description:
Role: Claims Handler - Defendant Personal Injury (EL/PL) Location: Leeds, West Yorkshire Contract: Full time, permanent, hybrid Salary: £28,000 - £32,000 CRA Consulting is pleased to be working alongside a well-established national law firm to recruit a Claims Handler into its expanding Defendant Personal Injury department. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a firm with a strong reputation within the insurance sector, acting on behalf of insurer and commercial clients across a broad range of personal injury matters. The team offers a collaborative working environment, high-quality training, and genuine opportunities for long-term career development.

The Opportunity

You'll take ownership of a caseload of defendant Employer's Liability and Public Liability claims, managing matters from initial instruction through to settlement. Working closely with colleagues and clients, you'll ensure claims are progressed efficiently, balancing excellent client service with commercial outcomes. Key responsibilities will include:
- Managing a varied caseload of defendant EL and PL claims through the MOJ Claims Portal.
- Investigating liability and quantum by reviewing evidence, medical reports and supporting documentation.
- Maintaining regular contact with insurer clients, claimant representatives, experts and other key stakeholders.
- Negotiating settlements and identifying opportunities to achieve commercially favourable outcomes.
- Pursuing recovery actions where appropriate.
- Maintaining accurate case records, financial reserves and risk assessments.
- Ensuring compliance with client protocols, regulatory requirements and internal quality standards.
- Contributing positively to team objectives while consistently meeting individual performance targets.

About You

Applications are welcomed from experienced Defendant Personal Injury Claims Handlers who enjoy managing their own caseload and working within a fast-paced environment. To be successful, you'll ideally have:
- Experience handling defendant EL and/or PL claims.
- Confidence using the MOJ Claims Portal.
- A solid understanding of liability, quantum and the personal injury claims process.
- Strong negotiation and communication skills.
- The ability to prioritise a busy workload while maintaining excellent attention to detail.
- A client-focused approach with a commitment to delivering a high standard of service.

Candidates with a background in defendant RTA claims who are keen to develop their expertise within Employer's Liability and Public Liability work are also encouraged to apply.

Benefits

Alongside a competitive salary, the firm offers an extensive benefits package designed to support both your professional development and wellbeing, including:
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Additional annual leave with length of service.
- Holiday purchase scheme.
- Enhanced pension contributions.
- Private healthcare.
- Life assurance.
- Enhanced family leave provisions.
- Discounted legal services.
- Employee Assistance Programme and wellbeing support.
- Reward and recognition initiatives.
- Regular social events and long service awards.
- Travel schemes.
- Hybrid and flexible working arrangements.

Why Join?

This is an excellent opportunity to become part of a highly regarded national practice that genuinely invests in its people. You'll benefit from quality work, a supportive team environment and structured career progression, whether you're already experienced in EL/PL claims or looking to make the move from defendant RTA into a broader personal injury role.

title: Experienced Medical Centre Receptionist
description: We are looking for a friendly, helpful and efficient individual(s) required for a busy GP surgery in Hunslet, Leeds. Hours are 30 - 37.5 per week over 4-5 days but must be flexible to swap shifts for holiday & any; sickness cover. We may consider two part timers depending on experience and flexibility. The post is varied and duties include: Complex patient enquiries, Pleasantly greeting patients, Sending referrals via online system, scanning patient documents, booking appointments, answering patient calls in a busy environment, processing prescriptions, working as part of a team and independently. Full training is given, but a friendly manner, accuracy and an attention to detail are all essential qualities for the post. The reception-admin team work in an open plan space, so an ability to concentrate on the task at hand, while remaining flexible to demands that arise is also needed. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Ensure that patients without appointments but who need an "urgent consultation" are seen in a logical and non-disruptive manner. Keeping up to date with all procedures and policies. Respond to all queries and requests for assistance from patients and other visitors, including medical reps. Ensure that request for repeat prescriptions are actioned, where possible, the same day, but certainly within 48 hours. Action requests for ambulance and/or hospital transportation and enter details in patient computer record. When necessary, liaise with hospitals and other agencies, as directed by doctor. Ensure reception and waiting areas are kept neat and tidy. Advise potentially new patients regarding registration. Inform patients of test results, as per practice policy. Book appointments, checking date of birth and address, ensuring that the correct patient is booked in and their computer details are correct and up to date. Prompt patients to amend registration details, as appropriate. We are seeking for a Medical Receptionist and Administrator to join our caring, friendly and busy practice at Arthington Medical Centre. The role of the medical receptionist and administrator will include responding to telephone queries, booking appointments, receiving patients at the reception desk and a host of administrative duties, for example scanning and processing documents, processing prescriptions, summarising patient records and registering patients amongst other duties. The applicant must have primary care experience however, comprehensive in-house training will be given along with a willingness to learn.

title: GP Receptionist / Care Navigator
description: Due to staff retirement, we are recruiting for a Care Navigator to join our team. The role will be part time, working 25 hours per week with the following shift pattern: Monday to Friday, 13:30pm-18:30pm. Working within the Robin Lane reception team, the post-holder will help provide a friendly and welcoming service for all patients. The Care Navigator will support patients to access the right health care in a professional and efficient manner. Follow practice processes to actively signpost patients to the most appropriate healthcare professional and service, whilst handling any complex queries and challenging situations in a professional manner, ensuring any issues are resolved where possible, at the first point of contact. Assist both clinical and admin colleagues with the smooth running of the reception area and surgery building.The post-holder is expected to comply with the employment policies and procedures, with due regard to clinical and information governance policies and procedures, and any other policies and procedures necessary for the safe and effective discharge of the duties contained within this document. This job description is subject to a flexibility clause and may change according to business requirements. This advert may close early should the right candidate be found. To welcome patients presenting either in person or by telephone; ensuring you respond promptly and positively. Book appointments for patients and cancel appointments where needed. Support patients in navigating to the most appropriate service, which may include informing patients of external health care providers and online services. Effectively handle all queries that present at the practice; problem solving, signposting and escalation of matters, as appropriate. Ensure patient records are accurate and kept up to date and that all patient contacts are documented in the system using the Care Navigation Template. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare providers. Carrying out administrative duties which include scanning, tasks, out of hours reports, new patient registrations (including basic urine dip), opening and sorting of post (both internal and external), photocopying reports, updating patient details, filing INR reports and data inputting as requested. Processing medication requests, including issuing repeat medication and appliance items, as well as forwarding patient requests onto the practice pharmacy team/on-call GP. Communicating effectively with local pharmacy staff and resolving/investigating any queries they may have. Processing e-consults via system one and triaging the patient accordingly using signposting where necessary. Opening up/locking up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols. Carry out chronic disease recalls and vaccination campaigns, booking relevant appointments working from a list to ensure clinics are fully utilised Informing patients of test results and following up with instructions from clinicians. Keeping the reception area and notice boards clean, tidy and up to date. Taking payments for private documents from patients and providing receipts Support all clinical staff with general tasks as required. Assisting the Site Co-ordinator with weekly fire alarm checks and weekly/monthly legionella testing, when required. Assisting the Site Co-ordinator with weekly room plans and petty cash records, when required. To be able to work with people from a wide variety of cultures and backgrounds, and people with disabilities and learning difficulties, and to be able to communicate with them (and, when necessary, their carers) appropriately to facilitate their care and understanding of their care within the service. Attend and positively contribute to team meetings. Fully comply with all company Health and Safety requirements, including reporting all accidents, near accidents, and hazards. Treat all patients fairly and with respect. Provide cover across all sites as required. This is not an exhaustive list, and it is expected that this role will develop as the business grows.
